title: Network Engineer (Generalist)
description:
We are seeking a Network Engineer (Generalist) to join our IT infrastructure team. This role is ideal for a versatile professional who can design, implement, and maintain network systems across a variety of environments. You will be responsible for ensuring reliable connectivity, optimizing performance, and supporting both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic initiatives.


Key Responsibilities

Design, configure, and maintain LAN, WAN, and wireless networks.

Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure uptime and reliability.

Implement and manage firewalls, VPNs, and other security measures.

Collaborate with system administrators and IT support teams to resolve technical challenges.

Document network configurations, procedures, and policies.

Evaluate new networking technologies and recommend improvements.

Provide support for network-related projects, upgrades, and migrations.

Ensure compliance with organizational and industry standards.


Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network protocols.

Experience with Cisco, Juniper, or similar networking equipment.

Familiarity with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.

Understanding of network security principles and best practices.

Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.


Preferred Skills

Experience with network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Nagios, PRTG).

Knowledge of VoIP systems and network QoS.

Scripting or automation skills (Python, PowerShell, etc.).

Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent

title: Global Process Data Consultant (OTC/MTO)/ SAP functional
description:
Global Process Data Consultant (OTC/MTO)/ SAP functional

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: 12+ Months

This role will be SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration - experience is required.

Position Purpose:

Client is currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.

Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference,

conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking

experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield

S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business

processes. This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose,

standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build,

migration, and adoption.

The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process

owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data

requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.

Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

* Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements

aligned to standardized value stream processes.

* Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data

definitions for S/4HANA.

* Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and

hierarchies across geographies.

* Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make,

Deliver, Return)

Functional Process Data Ownership

Responsibilities include:

* Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

* Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

* Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.

Data Migration & Readiness

* Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

* Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

* Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.

* Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.

Data Governance & Standards

* Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

* Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

* Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

* Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.

Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

* Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.

* Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

* Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

* Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.

Required Qualifications Experience

* 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

* Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

* Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

* Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

* Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.

Technical & Functional Skills

* Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business

Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

* Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.

* Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.

* Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).

* Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.

Soft Skills

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

* Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.

* Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.

* Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.

* Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.

* Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

They have a customized system, so it will take time for worker to come up to speed.

Must have strong SAP knowledge, understand fields and how they can be used.

Knowledge of master data is not critical, most data will be OTC, A/R data pricing, customer, pricing tables.

Must have recent SAP experience over the last 3 years.

title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype

title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous \"under the hood\" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in \"vibes.\" We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a \"Spray and Pray\" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.

Java, Springboot, mensageria, conceitos de devops, esteira CI/CD, terraform e AWS.

title: Full Stack AI Software Engineers
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: React, Redux, Mui, react-query, react-table, or Husky

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Remoto
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS automation / Tivoli)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Systems Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location : Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.


This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.


This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.


You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.


This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.


About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.


Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today


You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.


Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.



What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English


Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact


If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.


Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved


We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience


Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

title: Inference Systems Engineer
description:
Inference Systems Engineer

Remote

Infrastructure / Serving Systems

$5,651 - $6,469/month USD


Role Overview

As an Inference Systems Engineer, you will own the serving runtime that powers production LLM inference. This is a deeply technical role focused on system performance and stability: optimizing request lifecycle behavior, streaming correctness, batching/scheduling strategy, cache and memory behavior, and runtime execution efficiency. You will ship changes that improve TTFT, p95/p99 latency, throughput, and cost efficiency while preserving correctness and reliability under multi-tenant load.

You will collaborate closely with platform/infrastructure operations, networking, and API/control-plane teams to ensure the serving system behaves predictably in production and can be debugged quickly when incidents occur. This role is for engineers who can reason about the entire inference pipeline, validate improvements with rigorous measurement, and operate with production-grade discipline.


Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end serving runtime behavior: request lifecycle, streaming semantics, cancellation, retries interaction, timeouts, and consistent failure modes.
  • Design and implement batching and scheduling strategy: dynamic batching, admission control, fairness under mixed tenants, priority lanes, and backpressure mechanisms to prevent cascading failures.
  • Optimize performance at the systems level: reduce time-to-first-token, improve tail latency stability, increase tokens/sec throughput, and improve accelerator utilization under realistic workloads.
  • Improve memory behavior and cache efficiency: KV-cache policies, fragmentation control, eviction strategies, and safeguards against OOM cliffs and performance thrash.
  • Drive runtime execution optimizations: operator-level improvements, quantization integration, compilation/tuning paths where appropriate, and parameterization that produces stable performance across deployments.
  • Establish a performance measurement discipline: reproducible benchmarks, realistic traffic traces, profiling workflows, regression detection gates, and dashboards tied to production outcomes.
  • Build production readiness into the system: feature-flagged rollouts, canarying, safe configuration changes, and incident playbooks that reduce MTTR.
  • Partner with networking and infrastructure operations to align deployment topology, failure domains, and capacity constraints to performance and reliability goals.
  • Collaborate with product and API teams to ensure the serving layer's guarantees are reflected accurately in external interfaces and customer expectations.


Requirements

  • 5+ years building high-performance systems (model serving, GPU systems, performance engineering, or low-latency distributed systems).
  • Strong understanding of LLM inference tradeoffs: batching vs latency, prefill vs decode dynamics, cache behavior, memory pressure, and tail latency causes.
  • Comfort working across Python/C++ stacks with production profiling and debugging tools.
  • Track record of shipping performance improvements that hold up under production variance and operational constraints.
  • Strong engineering hygiene: tests, instrumentation, documentation, and careful rollout discipline.
  • Ability to communicate clearly across teams and operate calmly during incidents.

You will collaborate closely with platform/infrastructure operations, networking, and API/control-plane teams to ensure the serving system behaves predictably in production and can be debugged quickly when incidents occur. This role is for engineers who can reason about the entire inference pipeline, validate improvements with rigorous measurement, and operate with production-grade discipline.


Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end serving runtime behavior: request lifecycle, streaming semantics, cancellation, retries interaction, timeouts, and consistent failure modes.

  • Optimize performance at the systems level: reduce time-to-first-token, improve tail latency stability, increase tokens/sec throughput, and improve accelerator utilization under realistic workloads.
  • Improve memory behavior and cache efficiency: KV-cache policies, fragmentation control, eviction strategies, and safeguards against OOM cliffs and performance thrash.

Requirements

  • Strong understanding of LLM inference tradeoffs: batching vs latency, prefill vs decode dynamics, cache behavior, memory pressure, and tail latency causes.

  • Track record of shipping performance improvements that hold up under production variance and operational constraints.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Business Analyst Quality Assurance
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider merging innovation, expertise, and strategic insight. With headquarters in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India, MillionLogics is dedicated to delivering scalable, future-ready solutions. Specialising in Data & AI, Cloud solutions, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimisation, MillionLogics empowers organisations to evolve and drive digital transformation. Backed by over 40+ technology experts, the company ensures tailored, results-driven solutions for clients worldwide. For more details, visit: MillionLogics Services.


About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Experience : 1+ years of experience

Compensation : USD 1500 per month (net/take-home)

Joining: Immediate

Mode of Work : FULLY REMOTE

Number of positions : 75

Selection Criteria : Offline Assessment (No interview is required)


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.
  • Perks of Freelancing With Turing:
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30-40 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.
  • Duration: 18 months


How to apply? Please send us your updated cv to with JOB ID: 59315 as your email subject.

This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Experience : 1+ years of experience

Compensation : USD 1500 per month (net/take-home)

Joining: Immediate

Mode of Work : FULLY REMOTE

Number of positions : 75

Selection Criteria : Offline Assessment (No interview is required)


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.
  • Perks of Freelancing With Turing:
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30-40 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.
  • Duration: 18 months


How to apply? Please send us your updated cv to with JOB ID: 59315 as your email subject.

title: IT Project & Implementation Specialist
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar como especialista em Serviços Profissionais na Lynx Financial Crime Tech, com uma posição baseada no Brasil, em modelo remoto, em colaboração com o time global de Serviços Profissionais em Madrid (Espanha) e com foco em clientes no Brasil e em outros países da América Latina.

A Lynx Financial Crime Tech S.A, é uma empresa de software baseado em IA, especializada em detectar e prever padrões de comportamento. Liderados por uma equipe experiente do setor financeiro e acadêmico, desenvolvemos e implementamos tecnologias de IA de ponta e autoaprendizado. Nossa plataforma se destaca em tecnologias de processamento de transações de baixa latência e está disponível tanto on-premise quanto em nuvem.

Priorizamos VISÃO, AGILIDADE e VELOCIDADE para oferecer experiências excepcionais aos clientes e construímos relacionamentos duradouros e de confiança com algumas das principais instituições financeiras, fintechs e empresas comerciais em todo o mundo.

Adotamos uma forte cultura de risco e esperamos que toda a nossa equipe, independentemente do cargo que ocupem, tenha uma atitude proativa e responsável em relação à gestão de riscos. A Lynx se orgulha de ser uma organização com igualdade de oportunidades, independentemente de identidade de gênero, cultura ou deficiência. Nossa missão é contribuir para que mais pessoas e empresas prosperem.

O que você vai fazer

Como IT Project & Implementation Specialist, seu objetivo será garantir um serviço excelente para nossos clientes sediados no Brasil (e em outras regiões da América Latina), participando ativamente das diferentes etapas do ciclo de vida: onboarding, implantação, acompanhamento e novas necessidades.

Precisamos de alguém como você para nos ajudar em diferentes frentes:

· Liderar e gerir projetos de implementação das nossas soluções.

· Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes: identificar novas necessidades, resolver dúvidas e oferecer orientação sobre o uso correto das nossas soluções.

· Fornecer consultoria especializada e executar os serviços profissionais das nossas soluções de Detecção e Prevenção de Crime Financeiro e Lavagem de Dinheiro.

· Dar suporte técnico aos nossos times internos de Vendas nas fases iniciais de contato com clientes: demos, reuniões técnicas etc.

· Atuar como elo entre nossos clientes e as equipes de Desenvolvimento e Suporte.

✅ O que buscamos em você

Experiência em gestão de projetos de tecnologia;

Ensino superior completo;

Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras ou empresas relacionadas ao setor;

Experiência em departamentos de Serviços Profissionais em outras empresas do setor;

Idiomas: domínio avançado de inglês (mandatório).

✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

Conhecimentos de Linux – nível usuário.

Espanhol avançado;

Conhecimento em Fraude e/ou Lavagem de Dinheiro;

Capacidade para trabalhar em equipe;

Boas habilidades de comunicação;

Capacidade de se adaptar a ambientes em constante mudança.

Seguinte passo

Candidate-se e se você conhece alguém que possa estar procurando por essa oportunidade, compartilhe.

description:

Local: Escritório Pinheiros – São Paulo/SP | Modelo: 100% Presencial

Nível: Sênior


Chegou a sua hora de liderar a operação que transforma produto em imagem de alta performance!

No e-commerce da Centauro, o estúdio é um pilar estratégico da experiência do cliente. Cada foto e vídeo precisa traduzir qualidade, consistência visual e agilidade, respeitando o Style Guide da marca e os prazos do varejo.

Buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) de Estúdio para atuar como guardião da eficiência operacional e da excelência técnica, liderando o ciclo completo da produção visual — do planejamento dos calendários à entrega dos resultados — com foco em qualidade, dados e escalabilidade.


Seus desafios no jogo:

  • Atuar como aprovador(a) final da produção técnica e estética de fotos e vídeos, garantindo consistência de luz, cor, enquadramento e styling;
  • Manter e evoluir o Style Guide e os manuais de luz, assegurando padronização e identidade visual da marca;
  • Analisar causas de refações e rejeições, implementando melhorias imediatas nos processos e no set;
  • Planejar e gerenciar o calendário de shootings, coordenando prazos entre modelos, freelancers e times internos;
  • Gerir o fluxo completo das peças no estúdio, desde o recebimento até a entrega final para o e-commerce;
  • Liderar o time técnico (fotografia, vídeo, styling e edição), garantindo produtividade e cumprimento de SLAs;
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios de produtividade, custos e qualidade para a liderança e diretoria.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Superior completo em Fotografia, Publicidade e Propaganda, Moda, Design, Comunicação, Administração, Produção Audiovisual ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida na liderança de estúdios de moda ou e-commerce de alto volume;
  • Domínio do fluxo de produção visual ponta a ponta (planejamento, captura, edição e entrega);
  • Olhar crítico e técnico para auditoria de qualidade de imagem e vídeo;

  • Perfil analítico, com facilidade para transformar operação em dados e KPIs;
  • Boa comunicação para interação com times internos, parceiros externos e liderança.

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de fluxo e estúdio (Creative Force, ShotFlow, Monday, Airtable ou similares);

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team


Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.


This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.


Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems


Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation


Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch


System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic


Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health


Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

• Reduction in system errors or failures

• Time to resolve technical issues

• Successful internalization of GHL management

• System scalability and performance metrics


Required Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams


Preferred

• Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors

• Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations

• Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)


Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team


Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.


This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.


Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems


Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation


Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch


System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic


Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health


Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

• Reduction in system errors or failures

• Time to resolve technical issues

• Successful internalization of GHL management

• System scalability and performance metrics


Required Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams


Preferred

• Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors

• Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations

• Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)


Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

title: Unix Linux System Administrator
description:
Your role and responsibilities:


  • Lead L2/L3 production and project support for Linux environments
  • Manage installations, patching, migrations, and scripting (Shell & Perl)
  • Troubleshoot hardware/software issues across Linux, HP-UX, Solaris, and AIX
  • Optimize system performance and availability
  • Coach and mentor team members
  • Work with ITIL-based tools and monitoring systems


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Hands-on experience in Linux and Unix systems
  • Deep expertise in filesystem, volume, and storage management
  • Strong knowledge of networking, clustering (PCS), and system hardening
  • Familiarity with SAN/NAS, backup tools (TSM, VEEAM), and storage suites (EMC, NetApp, Hitachi)
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
  • Flexibility to work weekends and non-standard hours
  • Advanced English


Bonus Points:


  • Linux certification
  • German language skills
  • Experience with Veritas Cluster, Apache, DNS, DHCP, LDAP


Please submit resumé in English.

title: Account Manager
description:
Senior Account Manager – LATAM (International Contract | Remote)

Company: B2Hive Ltd.

Website:

Work Model: 100% Remote

Contract Type: International Contractor

Industry: Fintech | iGaming | Trading Platforms | Affiliate Marketing

Region: Latin America

About B2Hive

B2Hive Ltd. is a global technology provider specialized in White Label trading platforms for the digital financial market, with a strong focus on binary options and high-performance brokerage solutions . With strategic offices in Dubai (UAE), Limassol (Cyprus) and Seychelles , B2Hive operates in 30+ countries , delivering scalable technology, robust infrastructure and full operational support for brokers operating internationally.

Our solutions include:

  • High-performance trading platforms
  • Advanced backoffice and management systems
  • Global payment integrations
  • Affiliate and marketing modules
  • 24/7 specialized operational support

In 2026 , B2Hive launched a strategic expansion plan focused on Latin America , driven by the rapid growth of digital experts, influencers and affiliate ecosystems across the region.

Role Overview

We are hiring a Senior Account Manager to lead business development, sales and strategic account management of White Label brokerage solutions in LATAM. This is a senior, autonomous and results-driven position , focused on market development, high-ticket B2B sales and long-term client growth. The professional will act as the primary relationship owner between B2Hive and its brokers, combining commercial execution, account management and market intelligence.

Scope of the Position

Senior Account Manager – Brazil Market

  • Focus on business development and account management within the Brazilian market
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese required (C1 level or higher)
  • Demonstrated experience and professional network related to the Brazilian digital finance ecosystem

Senior Account Manager – LATAM Markets

  • Focus on Latin American markets
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish required (C1 level or higher)
  • Strong experience working with LATAM markets and regional business dynamics
Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Prospect, negotiate and close new White Label brokerage contracts
  • Conduct consultative B2B sales for high-value solutions
  • Manage the full commercial cycle: discovery → proposal → negotiation → closing
  • Leverage existing professional relationships to generate new opportunities
  • Represent B2Hive in negotiations with decision-makers and strategic partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Act as the main point of contact for assigned broker accounts
  • Support clients throughout their operational lifecycle
  • Work closely with internal teams (operations, marketing and support)
  • Drive broker performance, volume growth, retention and longevity

A relevant portion of compensation is directly tied to client performance, making post-sale account management a core responsibility.

Market Representation & Intelligence

  • Represent B2Hive at industry events, conferences and trade fairs
  • Expand institutional and commercial relationships
  • Identify partnership opportunities and acquisition channels
  • Monitor competitors, market movements and regulatory trends
  • Proactively suggest improvements to products, strategy and positioning

Pipeline & Reporting

  • Manage pipeline, forecasts and revenue predictability
  • Report results in a structured and data-driven manner
  • Operate with ownership mindset, efficiency and financial accountability
Required Qualifications
  • Minimum 2 years of proven experience in one or more of the following sectors: iGaming / Binary Options / Forex / Affiliate Marketing
  • Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, partnerships or affiliate management
  • Active professional network involving: Influencers, Digital experts, Affiliates, Brokers or betting operators
  • Proven ability to close high-value commercial deals
  • Experience working with international contracts and cross-border operations
  • High level of autonomy and strong results orientation
  • Availability to travel and attend strategic industry events
Professional Profile
  • Ownership mentality and strategic thinking
  • Strong self-management, discipline and organization
  • Clear, professional and persuasive communication
  • High networking and relationship-building capability
  • Emotional resilience and consistency in performance
  • Strong focus on efficiency, impact and revenue generation
Compensation Structure
  • Monthly fixed fee: USD 800 – USD 1,500 (based on seniority and profile alignment)
  • Sales commission: 10% per White Label platform sold
  • Recurring performance commission: 10% over operational results of active broker accounts

This model offers scalable and recurring earning potential , directly linked to client success and regional market expansion.

Application

This is a strategic position within B2Hive’s Latin America expansion plan, designed for professionals with established market experience and a strong commercial track record. If your profile aligns with this opportunity, please apply via LinkedIn or share your contact email and phone number so our recruitment team can initiate the interview process.

title: Account Manager
description:
Senior Account Manager – LATAM (International Contract | Remote)

Company: B2Hive Ltd.

Website:

Work Model: 100% Remote

Contract Type: International Contractor

Industry: Fintech | iGaming | Trading Platforms | Affiliate Marketing

Region: Latin America

About B2Hive

B2Hive Ltd. is a global technology provider specialized in White Label trading platforms for the digital financial market, with a strong focus on binary options and high-performance brokerage solutions . With strategic offices in Dubai (UAE), Limassol (Cyprus) and Seychelles , B2Hive operates in 30+ countries , delivering scalable technology, robust infrastructure and full operational support for brokers operating internationally.

Our solutions include:

  • High-performance trading platforms
  • Advanced backoffice and management systems
  • Global payment integrations
  • Affiliate and marketing modules
  • 24/7 specialized operational support

In 2026 , B2Hive launched a strategic expansion plan focused on Latin America , driven by the rapid growth of digital experts, influencers and affiliate ecosystems across the region.

Role Overview

We are hiring a Senior Account Manager to lead business development, sales and strategic account management of White Label brokerage solutions in LATAM. This is a senior, autonomous and results-driven position , focused on market development, high-ticket B2B sales and long-term client growth. The professional will act as the primary relationship owner between B2Hive and its brokers, combining commercial execution, account management and market intelligence.

Scope of the Position

Senior Account Manager – Brazil Market

  • Focus on business development and account management within the Brazilian market
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese required (C1 level or higher)
  • Demonstrated experience and professional network related to the Brazilian digital finance ecosystem

Senior Account Manager – LATAM Markets

  • Focus on Latin American markets
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish required (C1 level or higher)
  • Strong experience working with LATAM markets and regional business dynamics
Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Prospect, negotiate and close new White Label brokerage contracts
  • Conduct consultative B2B sales for high-value solutions
  • Manage the full commercial cycle: discovery → proposal → negotiation → closing
  • Leverage existing professional relationships to generate new opportunities
  • Represent B2Hive in negotiations with decision-makers and strategic partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Act as the main point of contact for assigned broker accounts
  • Support clients throughout their operational lifecycle
  • Work closely with internal teams (operations, marketing and support)
  • Drive broker performance, volume growth, retention and longevity

A relevant portion of compensation is directly tied to client performance, making post-sale account management a core responsibility.

Market Representation & Intelligence

  • Represent B2Hive at industry events, conferences and trade fairs
  • Expand institutional and commercial relationships
  • Identify partnership opportunities and acquisition channels
  • Monitor competitors, market movements and regulatory trends
  • Proactively suggest improvements to products, strategy and positioning

Pipeline & Reporting

  • Manage pipeline, forecasts and revenue predictability
  • Report results in a structured and data-driven manner
  • Operate with ownership mindset, efficiency and financial accountability
Required Qualifications
  • Minimum 2 years of proven experience in one or more of the following sectors: iGaming / Binary Options / Forex / Affiliate Marketing
  • Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, partnerships or affiliate management
  • Active professional network involving: Influencers, Digital experts, Affiliates, Brokers or betting operators
  • Proven ability to close high-value commercial deals
  • Experience working with international contracts and cross-border operations
  • High level of autonomy and strong results orientation
  • Availability to travel and attend strategic industry events
Professional Profile
  • Ownership mentality and strategic thinking
  • Strong self-management, discipline and organization
  • Clear, professional and persuasive communication
  • High networking and relationship-building capability
  • Emotional resilience and consistency in performance
  • Strong focus on efficiency, impact and revenue generation
Compensation Structure
  • Monthly fixed fee: USD 800 – USD 1,500 (based on seniority and profile alignment)
  • Sales commission: 10% per White Label platform sold
  • Recurring performance commission: 10% over operational results of active broker accounts

This model offers scalable and recurring earning potential , directly linked to client success and regional market expansion.

Application

This is a strategic position within B2Hive’s Latin America expansion plan, designed for professionals with established market experience and a strong commercial track record. If your profile aligns with this opportunity, please apply via LinkedIn or share your contact email and phone number so our recruitment team can initiate the interview process.

title: Líder Técnico II (Web/Mobile/Servidores)
description:
O Inatel está recrutando profissionais para atuação na liderança técnica de projetos de software no Inatel Competence Center - PDI SW.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar tecnicamente times e projetos de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Propor soluções que atendam ao negócio e sejam escaláveis, possuem protocolos de comunicação, regras de negócios e integração com equipamentos;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica do projeto, operacionais e de apoio à gerência;
  • Definir e documentar arquitetura lógica e executável de sistemas;
  • Realizar a especificação funcional de projetos;
  • Prover suporte ao time de QA;
  • Revisar código desenvolvido conforme boas práticas da tecnologia;
  • Projetar software para integração e entrega contínua;
  • Prover capacitação, orientação e suporte técnico aos desenvolvedores.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo na área de tecnologia, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Experiências em:

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções NodeJS ou .NET Core,
  • Angular e/ou React,
  • APIs Rest,
  • Arquitetura de soluções em cloud,
  • Arquitetura de microserviços,
  • Banco de dados não relacional/relacional,
  • Cultura DevOps,
  • Uso de ferramentas de design UX/UI,
  • Metodologias de desenvolvimento ágeis.


Domínio em:

  • Modelagem de projetos,
  • Ferramentas de análise de código e de controle de versionamento de código.


Conhecimento em:

  • Design patterns,
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicativo móvel,
  • Testes automatizados.


Seria interessante se você tivesse:


  • Capacidade de organização com múltiplas atividades e requisições simultâneas;
  • Capacidade de aprendizado e disseminação de conhecimento;
  • Inglês intermediário.

Informações adicionais

Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à sexta, das 08h às 12h e das 13h30 às 17h30.


Local de Trabalho: As atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".

title: Analista de Devops Pleno
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Responsável por promover a cultura DevOps através da disseminação de valores, princípios e práticas DevOps, com o objetivo de impulsionar a excelência operacional e maximizar a entrega de valor para os segmentos.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Auxiliar diferentes times de desenvolvimento de software, por meio da disseminação da cultura, ferramentas e práticas DevOps;
  • Apoiar a maturidade DevOps, através da aplicação de assessment;
  • Conduzir capacitações no mindset ágil e devsecops, através de workshops e vídeos;
  • Compartilhar padrões e boas práticas com os times, através de documentação e divulgação;
  • Auxiliar os times na utilização de plataformas de desenvolvimento, por meio de apoio técnico;
  • Pesquisar ferramentas que auxiliem no dia a dia da sustentabilidade do código, infraestrutura e organização, por meio de análise criteriosa sobre os impactos gerados;
  • Preservar os padrões estabelecidos corporativamente, por meio da orientação da importância da utilização dos mesmos e controle para identificar desvios nos processos;
  • Suportar processos de DevOps, através de ferramentas corporativas e boas práticas de mercado;
  • Elaborar apresentações técnicas, através de análise crítica sobre o tema abordado;
  • Apoiar o uso das ferramentas corporativas de DevOps, por meio de controles técnicos e acompanhamento de chamados;
  • Apoiar em migrações de ferramentas, por meio de participações em agendas para levantamento ou execução de atividades;


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

● Ferramentas de CI/CD (Ex: Azure Devops, GitHub, GitLab) - Nível Intermediário

● Administração de ambientes Cloud (Ex: AWS, Azure, GCP) - Nível Básico

● Ferramentas de Qualidade de Código (Ex: SonarQube, Checkmarx) - Desejável

● Ferramentas de controle de versão (Ex: Git) - Nível Intermediário

● Ferramentas de monitoração e observabilidade (Ex: Datadog) - Desejável

● Ferramentas de conteinerização (Ex: Docker, Kubernetes) - Nível Intermediário

● Ferramentas de automação através de Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (Ex:Ansible) - Nível Intermediário


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

title: GenAI Data Scientist
description:
Job Details:

Job Title: GenAI Data Scientist

Exp- Minimum 8 years

  • 100% remote/Long Term Contract/EST hrs.

Job Role-

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will translate the needs of our cross-functional stakeholders into user-facing applications that leverage NLP techniques and large language models (LLMs). As a Sr. Data Scientist on our GenAI applications team, you will work on products like conversational search interfaces, chatbots, text summarizers, recommender engines, and more based on the needs of the constituents. You will partner with Product Managers, Machine Learning Engineers, Cloud Platform Engineers, and cross-functional partners to develop production-grade algorithms.

You will contribute to the creation, delivery, and production of specific data science, machine learning and AI products for internal stakeholders; directly mentor other data professionals, data analysts, and machine learning engineers. In conjunction with the key partners, you will make technical decisions on data, technology, and ways of working

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Architect the overall framework and infrastructure for GenAI products like search interfaces, bots, summarizers, etc. Develop and implement techniques to optimize model performance to meet specific product goals
  • Collaborate closely with product management and engineering leads to align on technical roadmap. Guide engineering teams to effectively leverage LLM capabilities in product implementation.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what we do and how we do it; evaluate new data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation and business value. Proactively analyze latest developments in large language models to deeply understand model capabilities, limitations, and best practices. Develop techniques to continually improve language understanding and model training
  • Mentor and develop junior data scientists in state-of-the-art GenAI methods
  • Set technical vision and lead initiatives to accelerate product impact through cutting-edge LLM innovations
  • Complete other responsibilities as assigned.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Total Exp: 8 to 10yrs+
  • Advanced degree in mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, statistics, or an equivalent technical discipline.
  • Minimum of three years’ experience in developing machine learning models with a track record of creating meaningful business impact and working with multiple stakeholders.
  • Minimum of five years’ experience with Python.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience building production NLP and deep learning models using PyTorch/Tensorflow, along with using large language model architectures (BERT, GPT-3 etc.)
  • Experience building advanced workflows such as retrieval augmented generation, model chaining, dynamic prompting, PEFT/SFT, etc. using Langchain and similar tools
  • Experience establishing model guardrails and developing bias detection and mitigation techniques for AI applications
  • Proficiency with various prompting techniques, with a clear understanding of tradeoffs between prompting and finetuning
  • Experience with finetuning embedding models and tuning vector databases to improve performance of semantic search and retrieval systems
  • Deep understanding of underlying fundamentals such as Transformers, Self-Attention mechanisms that form the theoretical foundation of LLMs
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms and tools (AWS).
  • Experience operationalizing end-to-end machine learning applications.

title: Exchange Administrator
description:
About the Role:

Our client is looking for an experienced professional with a strong focus on the administration and support of Microsoft solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience managing corporate environments and working with mission-critical technologies that ensure business continuity. This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize Active Directory environments, including security policies, authentication, and organizational structures.
  • Create, review, and automate processes using PowerShell to increase efficiency and operational control.
  • Provide advanced-level technical support and troubleshooting, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, system migrations, and upgrades.
  • Be available to participate in an on-call rotation schedule, responding to incidents and critical issues as needed.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with Office 365, focusing on identity administration, licensing, and end-user support.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Active Directory, including DNS, Group Policies (GPOs), and authentication.
  • Advanced PowerShell skills, with the ability to build and maintain scripts for automation and problem resolution.
  • Conversational English is required, as the role involves interaction with international teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Availability to work under a contractor model.


Preferred Skills:

  • Microsoft certifications related to the responsibilities of the role.
  • AWS experience is a plus.

title: Engenheiro DevOps Sênior
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.

Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções tecnológicas para o segmento de seguros, contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.

Atuação 100% remota | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Remuneração: Dollar | Full-time

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar na redução de esforço operacional (operational toil), por meio da melhoria de automação , testes e confiabilidade da nossa infraestrutura em AWS e dos nossos pipelines de CI/CD . Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na eliminação de infraestrutura drift e na construção de testes end-to-end , contribuindo diretamente para a estabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência das plataformas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de automação com Terraform , garantindo consistência e evitando infraestrutura drift
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura e pipelines de testes end-to-end
  • Aprimorar pipelines de CI/CD no GitLab para deploys de infraestrutura e aplicações
  • Trabalhar com Terramate para gestão de infraestrutura como código
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia para garantir entregas confiáveis e automatizadas

Experiências esperadas

  • Experiencia com infraestrutura em cloud
  • Experiência em produção com Kubernetes , preferencialmente AWS EKS
  • Forte conhecimento em Terraform e Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experiência prática com AWS , incluindo EKS, RDS, S3 e serviços correlatos
  • Experiência em programação (perfil generalista é aceitável)
  • Stack utilizada: Python , Node.js e TypeScript
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD
  • GitLab CI é preferencial, mas uma base sólida em programação pode compensar

Ambiente técnico

  • AWS (EKS, RDS, S3 e outros serviços essenciais)
  • Terraform e Terramate para gestão de infraestrutura
  • GitLab CI para pipelines de deploy
  • Aplicações majoritariamente em Python (Django, FastAPI)
  • Parte do ecossistema em React, Node.js e TypeScript

Por que essa vaga pode ser ideal pra você?

Ambiente de aprendizado contínuo e espaço para crescimento

Time comprometido com excelência técnica

Cultura de feedback

Autonomia e respeito
